_doc: Dependency rules the graph enforces. These defaults are deliberately permissive (the regex classifier cannot tell a repository interface from its implementation). After the repo scan, tighten them to what the repo actually does: e.g. domain -> [domain] when repository interfaces live in domain. Only structural and behavioural edges between code nodes are checked. '*' allows everything.

dirs.note: feature-to-feature dependencies must go through shared/core
